claims.statement: The actions-metrics feature definition covers fpt/ghec. Frontmatter permissions allow organization owners and View organization Actions metrics holders to see organization metrics, and users with a base repository role to see repository metrics.

Included overview distinguishes usage metrics (workflow/job minutes and plan/cost analysis) from performance metrics (run/queue times and failures for efficiency and reliability). Neither constitutes an observed deployment result.

The enabling include permits organization owners to create custom organization roles with View organization Actions metrics to grant access; linked role documentation is not independently reviewed here.

Usage metrics cover workflows, jobs, repositories, runtime OS and runner type, helping compare consumption and identify possible optimization. Optimization examples are suggestions, not adopted obligations.

Performance metrics cover workflow/job failures and execution/queue times plus repositories, runtime OS and runner type. They support efficiency/reliability comparisons and do not certify freshness or completeness of an estate measurement.
The view-metrics how-to is a next-step link only; no dashboard access, permissions change or metrics retrieval was performed.
